item.description: ▶️ Save The Date! 📅 3-4 June 2026 ENDR Conference Gijón 2026 - “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry” In the framework of The European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Asturias Hub defensa ( ASTURIAS HUB DE DEFENSA) - Asturias Technology Business Association for the development of the Defence Industry - will host the European conference “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry”. 🗺️ The event will take place Gijón, Asturias (Spain), on 3-4 June 2026, at the Laboral Centro de Arte y Creación Industrial. 🔎 The conference will bring together key policymakers, industry leaders, SMEs, and stakeholders from the defence and dual-use entrepreneurial ecosystem, alongside civilian technology innovators, clusters, and defence business associations. It will also engage academia, research and technology organisations, higher education and VET providers, research funding bodies, specialised media, as well as EU, national, and regional authorities, and international organisations. Registration: https://lnkd.in/eT2Hjm8T Léo Benedetti Systematic Paris-Region, Karine JACQ, David Tonnard, Alexandre Hervin, Joachim Finkielman, Albert Boje Hviid, Paloma López Diez, Václav Syruček, Victor Hartong, Kristýna Helm, Goran Basarac, Bruno Grubesic, European Defence Fund, Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe (ASD), European Union Security and Defence, European Defence Agency, Slovenian Business & Research Association (SBRA)

item.description: 🔥🔥🔥 EUDIS Accelerator: new call for applications open! ▶️ Following the strong momentum of the EUDIS Business Accelerator — with over 450 applications from 27 countries in the previous cohort — a new call for applications is now open for Europe’s most promising defence and dual-use start-ups and scale-ups. ▶️ Supported by the European Defence Fund and DG DEFIS, the EUDIS Business Accelerator is an 8-month programme designed to help companies access and scale within the European defence ecosystem. ▶️ Selected companies of the 3rd cohort will benefit from tailored strategic support and expert coaching, on-site bootcamps across Europe to discover the European defence ecosystem, direct connections with end-users, industry leaders and investors and a €120,000 non-dilutive funding voucher per company. 🔥 Apply before 30 May 2026! https://lnkd.in/dDde8yzp. 📍 Register now to the information webinar of 29 April 2026: https://tally.so/r/PdYR8V Léo Benedetti Systematic Paris-Region, Karine JACQ, David Tonnard, Alexandre Hervin, Joachim Finkielman, Albert Boje Hviid, Paloma López Diez, Václav Syruček, Victor Hartong, Kristýna Helm, Goran Basarac, Bruno Grubesic, The European Network of Defence-related Regions, European Defence Fund, Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe (ASD), European Union Security and Defence, European Defence Agency, Slovenian Business & Research Association (SBRA)

item.description: 🚨🚨 EDF Work Programme 2026 released! 🚨🚨 Today, the EDF Work Programme 2026 was adopted by the Commission. All work programme files are available on DEFIS’ website: https://lnkd.in/efjYmBqp. The European Defence Fund’s annual Work Programme for 2026 will dedicate €1 billion to support collaborative defence R&D projects. With this new round of investments, the European Commission’s flagship for defence R&D will address 31 collaborative defence R&D topics, in critical and urgent areas in line with the commonly agreed capability development priorities. ▶️ More information on the dedicated press release: https://lnkd.in/eWeVzM-p. item.title: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All projec...
item.description: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All project the Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster (CDICC) currently hosts in Slovenia the second training workshop for EDF National Focal Points, alternates, and other members of national EDF teams, aiming to strengthen NFP’s practical EDF support knowledge and skills. A particular focus is set on the Slovenian EDF experience (both from EDF consortium leaders and partners) and the management of IPR in EDF projects. The EOA project consortium took advantage of this onsite gathering to hold its annual General Assembly. To close the 3-day workshop the Slovenian Ministry of Defence will tomorrow present its experience with EDF participation and emerging challenges. Participants will also be introduced to the GOIS Grozd obrambne industrije Slovenije, g.i.z. with discussions on national approaches to innovation, research and development, and the exchange of good practices. ⏪ You can replay previous EOA training and webinar sessions on EDF best practices are available on EOA’s Youtube channel: https://lnkd.in/euKYVBz2. Stay tuned ! 🎙️ Aleš Lipnik, Doit-R Solutions Aleksander majeric, TECES, Green Tech Cluster), coordinator of the INDY, Energy independent and efficient deployable military camps project (EDF 2021) and partner in NOMAD PROJECT EU(EDF 2021) and Sentinel Project (EDF 2024) Iztok Spacapan, Instrumentation Technologies and the ARCHYTAS (EDF) project (EDF 2023) Žiga Mlinarič, SkyLabs d.o.o. and the Staalion project (EDF 2023 SME development action project) Jan Knezevic, SSRD and the Small UAS project (EDF 2024) Ziga Brencic, Jozef Stefan Institute and the SQORPION project (EDF 2024) 🙋‍♂️ Léo Benedetti, Alain Dinis 💡 🌎, Alexandre Hervin, Joachim Finkielman, Paloma López Diez, Václav Syruček, Victor Hartong, Kristýna Helm, Goran Basarac, Grubesic Bruno The European Network of Defence-related Regions, European Defence Fund, Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe (ASD), European Union Security and Defence, European Defence Agency.

item.title: 📢 EU defence funding news! 📢 📌EDF 2025 figures A record 410 project proposals were submitted under EDF 2025 calls for co...
item.description: 📢 EU defence funding news! 📢 📌EDF 2025 figures A record 410 project proposals were submitted under EDF 2025 calls for collaborative defence research and development actions, marking an unprecedented level of interest since its launch in 2021, and representing an increase of 38% compared to 2024. Evaluation results are expected to be announced in April 2026. More information on EDF 2025: https://lnkd.in/dxzhH64x 📌 Political agreement reached on the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP) Along with the adoption of EU’s Defence Readiness Roadmap 2030 and a budget of €1.5 billion for 2025–2027, EDIP will accelerate the industrialisation of defence products, industrial ramp-up, support to European supply chains and SMEs, and the development of Ukraine's defence technological and industrial base. More information on specific rules and the timeline: https://lnkd.in/eVZP8hWH. item.title: 🚨 EUDIS Hackathons Spring 2026 open and info session! 🚨 The EUDIS Defence Hackathon Spring 2026 is now open to experienc...
item.description: 🚨 EUDIS Hackathons Spring 2026 open and info session! 🚨 The EUDIS Defence Hackathon Spring 2026 is now open to experienced innovators working on defence-relevant and dual-use technologies. From 26 to 28 March 2026, eight onsite hackathons across the EU and Norway will bring together startups, engineers, researchers and defence professionals to work on real airspace defence challenges alongside experts and end-users. To help interested teams better understand the opportunity, EUDIS Hackathon team is hosting an Info Session for participants on 4 March at 13:00 CET. During this session, you will understand what kind of profiles and technologies are encouraged to apply and how you can benefit from the event, explore the “Defending Airspace” operational challenges teams will address and meet the organisations behind this 4th edition. 👉 Register for the Info Session and learn more here: 🔗 https://lnkd.in/dS2_6kEA The hashtag #EUDISHackathon is organised by consortia leaded by Civitta together with CARSA, cecoforma events & communication, and Tehnopol, supporting the market entry and growth of new defence technology companies in Europe.
